subject.title: fix(agents): preserve runtime tool inheritance tokens

question: After resolving the current conflicts, should OpenClaw preserve filtered MCP/LSP runtime selector tokens in spawned child inherited allowlists as the authorization-boundary fix for this subagent MCP bug?
rationale: The change is security-boundary-sensitive because it controls which deferred plugin/runtime capability selectors can reach child sessions, and the branch conflicts with newer policy code on current main.

options.title: Refresh And Owner-Review
options.body: Resolve conflicts against current main while preserving newer declared-allowlist and cron policy-capture behavior, then require agent/gateway owner review of the refreshed merge result.

options.title: Replace Near Runtime Materialization
options.body: Pause this branch if owners prefer to solve selector inheritance at the embedded runtime construction boundary instead of the shared allowlist helper.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Owner-Review
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts against current main while preserving newer declared-allowlist and cron policy-capture behavior, then require agent/gateway owner review of the refreshed merge result.
